text: Ɓee fennooɓe habbitaaki si wanaa nde Malaa'ikaajo waroowo on, o ɓoora wonkiiji maɓɓe ɗin aduna, maa nde Joomi maɓɓe Arata Ñaawugol hakkunde maɓɓe laakara, maa nde yoga e maandeeji Joomi maa tinndinɗinayɗi Darngal arata. Ñalnde non yoga e maandeeji Joomi maa ari -wano fuɗirgol naange ngen mutal- gomɗinal keefeero nafoytaa, gomɗinal gomɗinɗo kadi nafoytaa si o gollaano moƴƴere ado nden ñalnde. Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe : "Habbitee gootun e ɗin piiji, menen doo meɗen habbitii".
